solution_title: Rideshare Booking, Fare Estimator & Live Driver Tracking
summary: Cross-framework Los Angeles rideshare booking, transparent fare estimation, eco-friendly route comparison, and live driver-dispatch simulation blueprint built exclusively with modern, zero-deprecation Google Maps Platform APIs (Maps JS API, AdvancedMarkerElement, PlaceAutocompleteElement, Place.searchByText, and Routes API v2 with TRAFFIC_AWARE_OPTIMAL, FUEL_EFFICIENT, and FUEL_CONSUMPTION). On initial load, pre-seeded Los Angeles pickup and drop-off locations resolve live via Places API (New), trigger dual fastest vs. eco-friendly route computation, render transparent Economy/Comfort/Green fares and fuel/CO2 savings, dispatch the closest simulated candidate vehicle, and smoothly animate its custom AdvancedMarkerElement along the pickup and trip polylines with live ETA updates.
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (2D Vector Map with mapId DEMO_MAP_ID & AdvancedMarkerElement)
Places API (New) (PlaceAutocompleteElement with gmp-select, Place.searchByText, and places:searchText)
Routes API (Route.computeRoutes, directions/v2:computeRoutes with FUEL_EFFICIENT & FUEL_CONSUMPTION, and distanceMatrix/v2:computeRouteMatrix)
Maps JavaScript API Geometry Library (encoding.decodePath & spherical heading/distance interpolation)
seed_search_query: Union Station, Los Angeles, CA to Santa Monica Pier, Santa Monica, CA
ui_layout_summary: Full-viewport split-screen layout with a 56px top header (branding, active LA trip summary, and live dispatch status badge), a scrollable 400px left control & telemetry sidebar (Trip Planner with pre-seeded pickup/drop-off PlaceAutocompleteElement inputs and swap button; Fastest vs. Eco-Friendly Route Comparison cards with fuel/CO2 savings banner and emission type selector; Economy/Comfort/Green Fare Estimator cards; and Live Driver Dispatch & ETA tracker with simulation controls), and a flex-1 right interactive Google Map canvas (explicit min-height: 560px / height: calc(100vh - 56px)) displaying both route polylines, pickup/drop-off/candidate-vehicle AdvancedMarkerElements, animated driver marker, and a floating route legend.
interactive_controls: data-testid="pickup-autocomplete" (PlaceAutocompleteElement container pre-seeded with Los Angeles Union Station)
data-testid="dropoff-autocomplete" (PlaceAutocompleteElement container pre-seeded with Santa Monica Pier)
data-testid="swap-locations-btn" (Swaps pickup and drop-off locations and recomputes routes)
data-testid="route-option-fastest" (Selects and highlights the TRAFFIC_AWARE_OPTIMAL fastest route)
data-testid="route-option-eco" (Selects and highlights the FUEL_EFFICIENT eco-friendly route)
data-testid="eco-savings-banner" (Displays live fuel/energy and CO2 savings between fastest and eco routes)
data-testid="emission-type-select" (Switches vehicleInfo.emissionType between GASOLINE, HYBRID, and ELECTRIC)
data-testid="fare-tier-economy" (Economy ride tier card with live distance/duration fare breakdown)
data-testid="fare-tier-comfort" (Comfort ride tier card with live distance/duration fare breakdown)
data-testid="fare-tier-green" (Green EV/Hybrid ride tier card with eco savings callout)
data-testid="dispatch-driver-btn" (Dispatches or restarts simulation of the closest candidate driver along pickup + trip polylines)
data-testid="toggle-simulation-btn" (Pauses or resumes live driver marker animation and ETA countdown)
data-testid="driver-live-eta" (Displays live driver status, remaining ETA, and distance to pickup/drop-off)
data-testid="rideshare-map" (Primary interactive Google Map container with explicit non-zero height >= 560px)
data-testid="map-route-legend" (Floating map legend distinguishing fastest route, eco route, pins, and live driver)

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Computes traffic-aware fastest (DEFAULT_ROUTE) and eco-friendly (FUEL_EFFICIENT) driving routes with FUEL_CONSUMPTION extra computation, plus driver-to-pickup approach polylines.
Evaluates live driving ETA and distance from nearby candidate drivers to the passenger pickup location to dispatch the closest driver.
Resolves pre-seeded or text-entered Los Angeles pickup and drop-off locations via Places API (New) Text Search on initial load and search fallback.
